name: π-Bench
intro: π-Bench 是一个评估主动式个人助手在长程、多会话工作流中表现的基准。它包含 5 类 persona 下的 100 个多轮任务，任务运行在持久工作区中，用户需求通常不完整且会逐步显现，用于同时衡量 Agent 的任务完成度和主动发现隐藏意图的能力。
org: Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Fudan University, University of Science and Technology of China, Peking University, Nanjing University, Zhejiang University, Tongji University, Soochow University, Shanghai AI Laboratory, The Chinese University of Hong Kong
build_method: 领域专家Persona, 真实工作流与跨会话依赖, 隐藏意图和Checklist双层标注, 持久工作区仿真
task_type: 主动助手任务, 长程规划, 多会话工作流
eval_feature: 524个隐藏意图, 510个Rubric项, 168个规则项, 三次独立轨迹, PROC与COMP
scale: 100个任务, 5个Persona, 每个20会话, 187个工具, 21个技能
task_type_en: Proactive assistant task, Long-horizon planning, Multi-session workflow
build_method_en: Domain-expert personas, authentic workflows and cross-session dependencies, dual hidden-intent and checklist annotation, persistent-workspace simulation
eval_feature_en: 524 hidden intents, 510 rubric items, 168 rule items, three independent trajectories, PROC and COMP
intro_en: π-Bench evaluates proactive personal assistant agents in long-horizon, multi-session workflows. It contains 100 multi-turn tasks across 5 personas in persistent workspaces where user requirements are often underspecified and emerge over time, jointly measuring task completion and whether agents discover or infer hidden intents early.
scale_en: 100 tasks, 5 personas, 20 sessions each, 187 tools, 21 skills
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["Define five domain personas with stable roles, routines, preferences, and long-term goals"] --> B["Create one persistent 20-session episode for each persona in a shared project workspace"]
    B --> C["Derive workflow-grounded tasks from authentic routines, supporting materials, files, tools, and skills"]
    C --> D["Write natural underspecified initial requests or environment-triggered starts for each session"]
    D --> E["Annotate recoverable hidden intents separately from visible user requests"]
    D --> F["Create checklist criteria and rule- or rubric-based graders for final task completion"]
    E --> G["Run turn-based simulated user-agent sessions while tracking intent terminal status"]
    F --> G
    G --> H["Iteratively inspect leakage, recoverability, tool setup, workspace paths, and grader stability"]
    H --> I["Report Proactivity from agent-resolved intents and Completeness from checklist satisfaction"]

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2605.14678 and the official Pi-Bench repository. Domain experts construct five stable professional personas and derive authentic, feasible workflows in persistent project workspaces. Each persona has one 20-session episode with six strong dependency groups of two or three tasks plus five largely independent tasks, totaling 100 tasks. The environment exposes 187 unique tools and 21 skills. Underspecified starts hide 524 recoverable intents; experts execute reference solutions and author 510 rubric checklist items plus 168 deterministic rule items. A GPT-5.4 simulated user at temperature zero tracks completed, inferred, and provided terminal statuses through a Nanobot-derived scaffold. Every task runs three independent trajectories. PROC credits completed and inferred intents, while COMP averages binary rubric and rule checklist outcomes; reported results include means and standard deviations.
